source.implements: Overview (before the battle): Warlord, enhancements, attached units, detachments (each opens its detachment rule), the army rules (folded), units with Deep Strike (24.09: every model must have it), transports, Scouts and Infiltrators (24.31, 24.20: every model must have it), start of the battle / round 1 / every round, once-per-battle items; the army rules block also holds the detachment rules (as on the Rules tab); an enhancement's holder by its full name when another unit of the list has the same short name

the list import (import.js): a New Recruit JSON export becomes a list only when its faction, battle size, detachments, Force Disposition (one its detachments allow), config (Code Chivalric) and every unit are exactly what data.js has: each unit with the characters attached to it (New Recruit's Leading/Supporting) has the BSData signature (signature) of a unit of a data.js list with the same faction, detachments and config, the same BSData names and the same points (BS_IDS, written by verify/import-ids.js); then the units are copied as data.js has them (a unit taken again as its copies; import-nr.js's order: role, units without a leader, the roster's order); otherwise nothing is imported and every item not recognized is listed (unit, option on unit, enhancement, detachment, disposition, warlord, leader attachment, points, faction)

a unit part's identity for the import: every selection below it as a path of BSData entry ids with its count (a models line's and a wargear item's count; an option holding models counts once), the same for the export and for BS_IDS

Import (the sheet): a refused export lists every message, one per line, and nothing is kept; an imported one is kept on the phone as the export (resolved again at every start), gets an id no list has, and opens
an imported list's Overview ends with where it came from and Remove this list (a confirm on the page: Remove / Keep it)
Remove: the list leaves the phone (the kept export and the list), the app goes to the home screen
